senses.gloss: to sparkle. Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ עד שתָּנֵץ החמה; Gen. R. s. 50, a. e. (Pes. 93ᵇ עד הנץ), v. הָנֵץ.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:10">Shebi. IV, 10</cite> <he>משיָנֵצּוּ</he>; <cite ref="Pesachim 53a:1">Pes. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>משיָנֵיצּוּ</he> (or <he>משיָנִיצוּ</he>) as soon as they blossom (expl. Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ <he>משהכניסו רובע</he>, v. <cite ref="N01091"><he>נֵץ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 147a:13">B. Bath. 147ᵃ</cite> <he>בשעה שיניצו</he> (Ms. M. <he>שהֵנֵיצּוּ</he>) when they are in blossom.
Koh. R. to XII, 5, v. צוּץ; a. fr.—2) to cause to sprout.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>מֵנֵיץ</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מציץ</he>), v. <cite ref="R00224"><he>צוּץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>נִיצְנְצָה בו רוה״ק</he> the spirit of prophecy was enkindled within him; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12">Cant. R. to I, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC</cite>, end, <he>נ׳ עליו מזיו וכ׳</he> a ray of the Divine Glory shone upon him, v. <cite ref="G00104"><he>זָהַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:10:1">Cant. R. to VI, 10</cite> <he>מְנַצְנֶצֶת ובאה</he> spreads wider and wider; (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII</cite> <he>מנפצת</he>).
